description: A button with a + icon whose icons bloom around it like petals; a second tap gathers them back with the same calm.
interactionNotes: Tapping the center button opens the petals one by one (each 35 milliseconds later than the previous) with a spring, each petal enters from a soft blur, and the `+` rotates into an X. A second tap closes the petals from last to first with a smooth transition. Space or Enter also opens and closes it, and on open, focus lands on the first petal so Tab reveals the rest; Escape closes it from anywhere and returns focus to the center button. A closed petal is kept out of the focus order and the accessibility tree with `inert`. Each petal is a real button; a click or Enter on it calls `onSelect` and closes the menu.

props.items: The menu items; each item has an `id`, a `label`, and an icon. The label goes to `aria-label` because the menu has no visible text.
props.open: Controlled state; omit it to let the component keep its own state.
props.onOpenChange: Called on every open or close.
props.radius: Radius of the bloom circle in pixels — the distance from each petal's center to the center of the menu.
props.accent: Color of the center button; the petals stay neutral. Pass a hex or `rgb()` — the `+` icon's ink automatically turns dark or light to stay readable on any color.
props.stagger: Staggered delay of each petal in milliseconds; closing uses the same step but reversed.
props.stiffness: Stiffness of the opening spring — higher means snappier.
props.damping: Spring damping; a lower value gives more bounce.
props.blurIn: Blur of the petals before opening, in pixels; set it to zero for a sharp entrance.
props.autoPreview: Site preview only — it runs an endless open/close cycle by itself. Keep it off in normal use.
props.ariaLabel: Label of the center button for screen readers.
props.onSelect: On selecting any petal (click or Enter) it returns the item and the menu closes itself; it is optional, and without it the menu just closes.
props.className: Extra class for the menu frame.

tips: The circle is symmetric and has no directional arrow, so nothing is mirrored for RTL — the geometry stays physical and the frame center is the same point in both directions.
The menu frame grows with the bloom radius (it is not fixed), so even a large radius does not overflow the frame; just watch the height of the host card.

The disc shadows are controlled by the `--fm-disc` variable in the CSS file and switch themselves in the dark theme with a `.dark` selector; if your project uses a different theme class, change that one selector.
Closed petals have `tabIndex={-1}` and `aria-hidden` — common implementations made them invisible but still tabbable; this one fixes that.
With `prefers-reduced-motion` all transitions become instant: the petals move without a spring and the staggered delay drops to zero.
